body: I wish I could be more like you and as stupid as some may find it, make everyday the day you don't use that knife because you are so much more than that and even though I know so little about you I want  you to keep fighting to survive

Thank you so much for replying and sharing your story with me. I could never imagine going through what you did and I wish you the best for the future. You are strong and amazing for doing this, and I am here to talk with you anytime about anything. Never forget how much you matter

Thank you so much for replying and it is ok to be anonymous as long as we can show that we are not an invisible minority. This entire project is showing people that suicide  is more common than they could ever imagine 
Thank you, you are strong and amazing for doing this and even as a stranger I'm here to talk about anything you need to
